get.summary: Read the dependency-aware release work queue
get.description:
Returns a bounded, read-only snapshot of direct release members and
their transitive live prerequisites. Tasks with no prerequisites are
claimable when otherwise eligible. Queue dispositions classify
completed, owned, claimable, dependency-blocked, manually blocked,
foreign-claimed, and cross-release-conflict work. Results are ordered
with owned work first, then claimable work in topological prerequisite
order, with priority, board position, task number, and ID tie-breakers.
The queue never claims or mutates tasks.

The cursor captures release version, project/task-collection revision,
filter, and read timestamp. Any task, dependency, claim, or release
change invalidates it with `409 release_queue_changed`; discard the
cursor and restart from the first page.

200.description: Snapshot of the dependency-aware release queue.
